title: Pipe chart fit fix — no more clipped spheres
description:
The pipe chart was still clipping the From/To end caps on longer runs because observation tags spilled into the sphere rows and got cut by the panel edge. Tags now shrink and re-seat entirely inside the pipe track, end caps scale down when the panel is short, and the full From-to-To chart stays visible without weird clipping.

Pipe marks remain locked to true chainage. Only the tag sizes and their display spacing adjust so everything fits cleanly.

Who is affected: everyone on the private server, and on SaaS after Push.
changeLog: Pipe chart observation tags stay inside the track — no more bleeding over From/To spheres.
Tags shrink and re-space automatically based on panel height and observation count.
End-cap spheres and labels scale down on short panels so the full run stays visible.
Overflow clipping that cut through the top/bottom of the chart is fixed.
